pages.title: New to the building
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’m new here. Do I have to book the grill?
lines.audioText: I’m new here. Do I have to book the grill?
lines.translation: Sou nova aqui. Preciso reservar a churrasqueira?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, you have to book it at reception. It’s free
lines.audioText: Yes, you have to book it at reception. It’s free.
lines.translation: Sim, você precisa reservar na recepção. É grátis

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Can we use the pool after dinner?
lines.audioText: Can we use the pool after dinner?
lines.translation: Podemos usar a piscina depois do jantar?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Until eight. You mustn’t use it after that
lines.audioText: Until eight. You mustn’t use it after that.
lines.translation: Até as oito. Não se pode usar depois disso

questions.prompt: How do residents book the grill?
questions.answer: Residents have to book the grill at reception

questions.prompt: Does using the grill cost anything?
questions.answer: No, using the grill is free

questions.prompt: When must residents stop using the pool?
questions.answer: Residents must stop using the pool at eight

pages.title: What you need to bring
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: All right. Do I have to bring my own chairs?
lines.audioText: All right. Do I have to bring my own chairs?
lines.translation: Tudo bem. Preciso levar minhas próprias cadeiras?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No, you don’t have to. There are six chairs by the grill
lines.audioText: No, you don’t have to. There are six chairs by the grill.
lines.translation: Não precisa. Tem seis cadeiras perto da churrasqueira

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Great. One more thing: can I take my bike in the lift?
lines.audioText: Great. One more thing: can I take my bike in the lift?
lines.translation: Ótimo. Mais uma coisa: posso levar a bicicleta no elevador?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Sorry, you can’t. Please leave it in the garage
lines.audioText: Sorry, you can’t. Please leave it in the garage.
lines.translation: Desculpe, não pode. Por favor, deixe-a na garagem

pages.title: Plan it within the rules

pages.title: An earlier closing time
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! There’s a temporary change this weekend. The pool closes at six, not eight, because of cleaning. The grill booking is still fine, and you can use the chairs. If your friends want to swim, they should come before six. Could you tell them about the earlier closing time? Everything goes back to normal on Monday
